headline: Change of Heart
title: Change of Heart Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Change of Heart. What is it? It is a Normal Spell Card. What does it do? Take control of one monster your opponent controls until the End Phase. How do you use it? Steal their best monster, attack with it, or use it as a Tribute so they never get it back. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
